about_the_game:
Fabled Forest is a fantasy-themed simulation and management game where you play as a young wizard who opens a restaurant in a magical world and befriends creatures from different races.

Serve dishes while flying on your broomstick, let enchanted flames cook in your place—after all, what wizard would cook by hand? To keep your restaurant running, you’ll need to gather ingredients: harvest crops, fish in sparkling lakes, trade with other races, and uncover treasures during mystical adventures.

The game features a free plating system, allowing you to experiment with creative dish presentation. By paying attention to customer hints and discovering their favorite flavors, you can earn higher rewards and build a loyal clientele. Every guest has unique preferences, making attentive management the key to success.

Expand your restaurant empire across five distinct regions—the World Tree, Frozen Tundra, Misty Isles, Volcano, and Ocean. Each area introduces new ingredients, characters, and opportunities to grow your magical community.

In Fabled Forest, food is more than business—it is the magic that connects worlds and friendships.
